answer: In an agent market trading ferrous scrap at a harbor, each seller must lock $100 in collateral for every $20 of unsettled orders, with funds held until delivery is verified. Proven nondelivery forfeits the bond. Splitting one seller into a thousand fake agents creates no extra credit because every account faces the same collateral rule. Each $20 delta in attack capacity costs another $100 locked up and exposed to loss.
